lcc_original: 以諾跟上帝往來，上帝將他取去，他就不在了。
notes: 與→跟: both mean 'with/together'; WAH0854 transfers cleanly
神→上帝: systematic UNV/LCC difference for H0430 (אֱלֹהִים)
同行→往來: UNV 'walk together', LCC 'commune/go back and forth'; both render H01980 (הָלַךְ), morphology WTH8691 attached to 往來
{<WAH03588>} retained as implicit: Hebrew כִּי is absent as an explicit word in LCC; the comma serves that role
UNV '世' has no SN and LCC omits it entirely — no alignment needed; WAH0369 attaches to 不在 in both versions
